summary.text: Vanessa Summers is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 99 since 1991 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as special projects coordinator at the Julian Center.

paragraphs.text: Summers attended the Mid American College of Mortuary Science, which Ballotpedia lists as 1980.
Her professional experience includes working as a special projects coordinator at the Julian Center and as a funeral director and embalmer with Summers Funeral Home.
Summers first assumed office in the Indiana House in 1991.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Family, Children and Human Affairs, House Local Government and House Public Policy committees.
